# Anakin AI

> > Anakin AI: Platform for AI automation and vector database integration with comprehensive guides for Milvus, LangChain, LlamaIndex, and Claude.

Anakin AI provides technical documentation and tutorials focused on vector database operations, AI model integration, and framework interoperability. The platform specializes in practical guides for developers working with Milvus vector databases, LangChain, LlamaIndex, and various AI models including Claude and OpenAI.

## Vector Database API Reference

- [How to Use to_numpy API for Vector Databases](http://anakin.ai/blog/how-to-use-to_numpy-api-for-vector-databases): Guide to to_numpy operations in Milvus vector databases with Python code
- [How to Use EmbeddingList API for Vector Databases](http://anakin.ai/blog/how-to-use-embeddinglist-api-for-vector-databases): EmbeddingList API tutorial for Milvus with batch operations and examples
- [How to Use index API for Vector Databases](http://anakin.ai/blog/how-to-use-index-api-for-vector-databases): Index API operations guide with Python, REST, and performance optimization
- [How to Use Get Load State API for Vector Databases](http://anakin.ai/blog/how-to-use-get-load-state-api-for-vector-databases): Get Load State API for checking vector collection memory status via REST
- [How to Use encode_queries API for Vector Databases](http://anakin.ai/blog/how-to-use-encode_queries-api-for-vector-databases): encode_queries API guide for embedding models with batch operations
- [How to Use create_resource_group API for Vector Databases](http://anakin.ai/blog/how-to-use-create_resource_group-api-for-vector-databases): Milvus create_resource_group API for vector database resource management
- [How to Use get_compaction_state API for Vector Databases](http://anakin.ai/blog/how-to-use-get_compaction_state-api-for-vector-databases): Milvus get_compaction_state API for database optimization operations
- [How to Use add_field API for Vector Databases](http://anakin.ai/blog/how-to-use-add_field-api-for-vector-databases): Milvus add_field API tutorial for vector database schema modifications
- [How to Use get API for Vector Databases](http://anakin.ai/blog/how-to-use-get-api-for-vector-databases-2): Vector database get API operations with RESTful HTTP and Python examples
